messages:
rachel: opened a small PR to clarify fallback behavior in the model-catalog and to add an SDK v4 snippet showing per-request opt-out and priority. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9812

ben: can you mark models that are KV-cache sensitive? i'd rather not have fallback enabled by default for those.

rachel: yes — PR proposes `fallback_status: conditional` and a `fallback_constraints` note in the model card YAML. For KV-cache sensitive models we set `fallback_constraints: \"no-kv-cache; seq_ceiling=4096\"`.

mei: add an example for per-request opt-out and a short sample showing `fallback_priority`. ops wants a quick-copy snippet for the migration guide.

rachel: pasted snippet in PR: 

```js
// SDK v4: per-request opt-out and fallback priority
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })

await client.generate({
  model: 'aurora-lite3b@2026-09-01',
  input: 'Summarize the new model catalog fields',
  routing: {
    opt_out_fallback: false, // set true to forbid fallback for this call
    fallback_priority: ['aurora-lite3b', 'aurora-lite3b-q2']
  }
})
```

ben: nice. also include one-line note about metrics: fallback increases token-cost variance and can complicate Dedicated pool attribution.

rachel: added that and linked to Console docs. docs-bot: please run link-check and snippet-lint.

docs-bot: running checks for PR #9812. snippet-lint: warning -> missing semicolon on line 3 of snippet (cosmetic). Link-check: internal S3 link in PR comments returns 403 (internal-only).

mei: fix semicolon, we'll keep the S3 CSV as internal-only but paste a public summary in the PR body.

rachel: done; semicolon fixed and CSV excerpt pasted. merging after the green check.

docs-bot: final checks passed. PR merged.

ben: follow-up: I'll sweep long-context model cards tomorrow and add `fallback_constraints` where needed.

mei: i'll port the snippet into the migration guide and add a short note about forcing fallback for batch jobs (`preferred_fallback: true`).
